summary: The solution implements a 5-fold cross-validation ensemble using LightGBM and CatBoost, correctly formatting the target predictions. However, it fails to engineer any derived features and uses a naive equal-weight ensemble. Furthermore, it neglects to calculate any validation metric during cross-validation and subtly leaks validation fold information into training folds by computing imputation statistics on the entire training set before splitting.
